page.overview:
Who is Gwen?

Gwen was a witcher of the School of the Wolf who trained under Vesemir.

During his training alongside fellow trainees Geralt, Gweld, and Hemminks, Gwen participated in a training exercise led by Vesemir. In this exercise, blunt crossbow bolts were fired at the witchers to teach them how to parry the bolts with their swords. Unfortunately, both Gwen and Hemminks failed to block the bolts and were hit. When they were being prepared to be taken to the infirmary for treatment, one of the witchers remarked that Gwen might need to be taken directly to the sand for burial, as he had been struck in the eye by a bolt.
